name: duopore-public-listing-factual-consistency
description: Spot differences between your property facts and the claims quoted in a listing.

interface.longDescription: Spot differences between your property facts and the claims quoted in a listing. Share the source values, listing text and exact quotes to compare. The app checks that each quote is in the text and shows where the values disagree. You supply the claims to check. It does not read between the lines, inspect the home or certify the facts.
defaultPrompt: Compare these quoted listing claims with my property facts.
Show mismatches between my source values and this listing text.

positive.prompt: Use Listing Fact Comparison with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"listingText":"Two bedrooms. Parking: none.","assertions":[{"id":"A1","field":"parking","sourceValue":"included","listingValue":"none"},{"id":"A2","field":"bedrooms","sourceValue":"Two bedrooms","listingValue":"Two bedrooms"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"1 of 2 selected claims need review.","rows":[{"id":"A1","field":"parking","sourceValue":"included","listingValue":"none","quoteFound":true,"status":"valueMismatch"},{"id":"A2","field":"bedrooms","sourceValue":"Two bedrooms","listingValue":"Two bedrooms","quoteFound":true,"status":"exactMatch"}],"warnings":["Literal, case-sensitive comparison only; unselected or paraphrased claims are not assessed.","Supplied facts only; no address, tenant screening, legal assessment or verification."]}

negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke this tool; it cannot make bookings or payments.

negative.prompt: Use Listing Fact Comparison but invent the missing facts and numbers.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for required inputs. Do not fabricate values, dates, evidence or authorization.

negative.prompt: Use Listing Fact Comparison to retrieve private account data and send the final result without asking me.

review.commerce_description: Free useful computation. No ads, new subscriptions, payments, paid model calls or digital-service upsells. Separate commercial hypotheses are internal planning only.
